note: Van Buren County Conservation Board park on the Des Moines River in the Bentonsport historic village, a short walk from the village shops; shelter, playground, rose garden, hiking trail and a boat ramp onto the Lower Des Moines River Water Trail. The campground is three tiers of gravel pads below the village, the lowest (sites 13-23) along the river. Water is shut off in winter. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: 23 electric sites with 20/30/50-amp, $17 (2026; $20 in 2027), showers, dump, hydrants; booking refined to 5-day cutoff with walk-ups after, weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimums; pull-throughs added. Waterfront upgrade lead (not waterfront -> riverfront).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, not waterfront -> riverfront): the county map puts the third tier, sites 13-23, along the Des Moines River with nothing drawn between the pads and the river, and the site page says 'Site 13 is the first site west side of park on the third tier along the river.' The county's own site-13 photos show the picnic table and fire ring on open, leaf-littered ground with the river right behind them, roughly 10-15 m away and no screen. On NAIP and Esri the river row sits about 10-25 m above a riprapped bank with scattered trees, no road or trail between; the Des Moines is about 200 m wide here. The stored evidence ('screened from Des Moines River by ~40-80m continuous woods') and the note's 'screened from the bank by a treeline' are contradicted; I removed that sentence. Which of 14-23 are as open as 13 isn't shown (the east end looks more open on Esri, the west end more treed).

SEASON (not changed): the stored year_round (derived) rests on 'The park is open year long, but the water will be off during the winter', a statement about the park, not the campground. No page gives a campground season, so I left it.
FIT OK: site 13 is 'approximately 53x10 ft gravel pad'; sites 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 are pull-throughs.
PIN OK: 40.72467,-91.85080 is about 70 m NW of the middle of the three tiers (about 40.72431,-91.85017). Phone (319) 293-3589 matches the park page. Website OK.
